content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments provide a decentralized method for processing transactions using blockchain technology. This approach empowers creators to sell digital products directly to consumers without relying on conventional payment gateways. Unlike platforms like Gumroad that charge up to 10% per sale, NOWPayments only incurs a minimal 0.5% fee. For a creator selling a $97 ebook with 100 sales monthly, this fee difference translates to retaining an additional $921, making a compelling case for adopting Solana as a payment method.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture behind Solana payments for digital products integrates several key components that ensure seamless transactions. Using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate order processing and delivery of digital products. With NOWPayments handling on-chain crypto payment verification, creators can accept multiple cryptocurrencies without incurring high transaction fees. This infrastructure not only enhances speed and reliability but also ensures that creators maintain full control over their data and transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions with limited access to traditional payment processors. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, the Solana payment system allows you to circumvent the obstacles imposed by platforms like PayPal and Gumroad. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can enjoy lower fees, retain more earnings, and ultimately build a sustainable online business without reliance on third-party platforms.
Retain more of your earnings by choosing Solana payments over traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of Solana payments involves a combination of tools and services that work in harmony. Utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, along with backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensures that your digital products are delivered automatically upon payment confirmation. By integrating NOWPayments, creators can easily manage crypto transactions with minimal fees, making this ecosystem both cost-effective and efficient for selling digital goods.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your digital products using Solana payments, first, set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate your order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment verification and configure your digital product delivery through platforms like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This structured approach allows you to launch your digital commerce stack effectively and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be achieved by utilizing blockchain-based payment solutions like Solana. By adopting services such as NOWPayments, creators can accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing traditional platforms entirely. This method not only lowers transaction fees but also provides greater control over sales and earnings.
Enjoy complete control over your digital commerce stack with no ongoing subscriptions.

Begin by creating an account on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital products. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order automation. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly. Set up file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure instant access for customers.
